title: field ops
description: Deep schema for op.type starting with 'field.'. Field strategy (decision #10): add uses the incremental add-fields path (preserves auto reverse controls); update/delete/reorder use read-full-controls -> mutate -> write-back-full (update-fields).

field.description: A field definition (clean, name-referenced). 'type' is the field type code (Text, Number, Relation, ...).

relation.description: Relation fields: which worksheet the records come from.

worksheet.description: Worksheet the related records come from — name or id.

showFields.description: Columns of the far worksheet to surface — names or ids.

lookup.description: Lookup fields: mirror a column of a related record.

via.description: Relation column on this worksheet to reach the other one through — name or id.

field.description: Column on the far worksheet to mirror — name or id.

rollup.description: Rollup fields: add up a column of the related records.

via.description: Sub-table or multi-record relation column on this worksheet — name or id.

field.description: Column on the far worksheet to add up — name or id.

subtable.description: Sub-table fields: either the columns of a new child worksheet (fields), or an existing worksheet to mount (worksheet). Exactly one of the two.

fields.description: Columns of the child worksheet to create, in the same clean form as a top-level field.

worksheet.description: Existing worksheet to mount as the sub-table — name or id.

showFields.description: Which child columns the inline list shows — names or ids. Defaults to all visible ones.

control.description: Raw control keys, merged last. Escape hatch for shapes the clean vocabulary does not model.

field.description: Target field: name, alias, or controlId.

set.description: Raw control keys merged onto the existing control (read-modify-write). E.g. {"required": true}, {"options": [...]}. The full control set is written back, so other fields/reverse controls are preserved.

field.description: Field name or controlId to remove.

order.description: Field names/controlIds in the desired order.
